desc: Read input N, K, and array A.
Precompute binomial coefficients C(K, k) for k in 0..K.
For each k from 0 to K, iterate r from 1 to N, maintaining a running sum of S[j]^k for j < r, and accumulate the term C(K,k)*(-1)^k * S[r]^(K-k) * (sum of S[j]^k).
Sum all contributions modulo 998244353 and print the result.
